**📈 Thu 26 Nov: No clean setups today** (from 25 Nov close). 1 of 472 stocks passed. Valid 26 Nov, 27 Nov, 30 Nov.

**💡 Today's learning: "Lightning never strikes the same place twice"**
- **🤔 What people believe:** Once lightning hits a spot, that spot is safe from being hit again.
- **🔬 The fact:** Britannica says lightning can strike the same place twice, even in the same storm. Tall buildings like the Empire State Building are "nearly guaranteed" to be struck every time a thunderstorm passes over, and the US alone gets about 20 million cloud-to-ground strikes a year.
- **🎯 How they fool you:** Nobody sells this one: it is a comforting saying about bad luck. Strikes at any one spot feel rare, so we assume a hit spot is now safe (the gambler's fallacy). Tall, pointed things get hit again and again.
- Source: https://www.britannica.com/story/can-lightning-strike-the-same-place-twice
